objective: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.
start: Dropped by many mobs in Duskwood

description: Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine.  Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.
It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
progress: Ooh! What's that old book you have there? Can I see it??
completion: Oh my! This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago. It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.
Thank you, <name>. Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
